2609.25467.title: ShowTellArena: Evaluating Business Workflow Understanding from Demonstrations
2609.25467.paper_summary: We often teach a colleague by showing the work and explaining the decisions as we go. How can we check what an agent understood from the same lesson? We introduce ShowTellArena, a benchmark protocol and public dataset for comprehension after narrated business demonstrations. The v1.0 release contains 50 business workflow tasks, with recordings, screenshots, narration, fixture seeds, and 502 questions. Tasks span finance, hiring, procurement, customer decisions, inventory, and logistics. The protocol holds the business scenario and quiz fixed while allowing each product to capture the lesson through its own teaching interface. Questions test operational rules, boundaries, exceptions, and errors in proposed automations. We analyze 218 selected pilot attempts across 39 workflow cases, including 28 cases attempted by all three evaluated systems. These exploratory results expose both answer errors and failures to complete the teaching experience. We describe the release's verification gaps and the pilot's uneven coverage, exclusions, and grading provenance. The contribution is an inspectable dataset and assessment workflow that others can extend; the selected pilot is not a controlled product ranking.
2609.25467.paper_summary_zh: 我們經常通過展示工作並在過程中解釋決策來教導同事。<lb/>我們如何檢查代理從同一課程中理解了什麼？<lb/>我們介紹了ShowTellArena，一個基準協議和公共數據集，用於在敘述商業演示後的理解測試。<lb/>v1.0版本包含50個商業工作流程任務，包含錄音、截圖、敘述、固定種子和502個問題。<lb/>任務涵蓋財務、招聘、採購、客戶決策、庫存和物流。<lb/>該協議保持商業場景和測驗不變，同時允許每個產品通過自己的教學界面捕捉課程。<lb/>問題測試提議自動化中的操作規則、邊界、例外和錯誤。<lb/>我們分析了39個工作流程案例中218個選定的試點嘗試，包括所有三個評估系統都嘗試的28個案例。<lb/>這些探索性結果揭示了答案錯誤和未能完成教學體驗的情況。<lb/>我們描述了版本的驗證差距以及試點的不均勻覆蓋、排除和評分來源。<lb/>這一貢獻是一個可檢查的數據集和評估工作流程，其他人可以擴展；所選的試點不是一個受控的產品排名。
